news.headline: Rosenblatt Maintains Buy on Cisco Systems, Lowers Price Target to $140
US AI Data Centers ‘Are Going to Get Built’ Despite Political Pushback, Says Cisco CEO: ‘Too Important to Our Country’
news.summary: Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins says U.S. AI data centers will get built despite political pushback and sees no demand shift overseas.

news.headline: Cisco Systems Raises Fiscal 2027 Revenue Forecast
news.summary: Cisco Systems, Inc. has raised its annual revenue forecast for fiscal 2027, citing strong demand for its AI-powered networking solutions.

news.headline: SemiAnalysis Suspects US Intelligence Role in Jensen Huang’s Exit as China Chip Crackdown Looms
news.summary: SemiAnalysis says U.S. intelligence may have helped push Jensen Huang out as Washington weighs tougher China chip restrictions

news.headline: Jensen Huang Faces Subpoena Threat As 3 Republican-Led House Committees Demand Closed-Door Testimony Over Nvidia’s China Ties
news.summary: GOP-led House committees give Jensen Huang a Friday deadline to testify on Nvidia's China ties or face a subpoena.

news.headline: NVIDIA Confirms South Korea GPU Supply Commitment
news.summary: NVIDIA has reaffirmed its commitment to supply 260,000 GPUs to South Korea for AI infrastructure projects despite the recent leadership transition.

news.headline: Alphabet's Google Signs MoU with ENGIE for Potential French Data Center Energy Supply
news.summary: Google has entered into a memorandum of understanding with ENGIE to explore a potential energy supply agreement for a proposed data center project in France.

news.headline: Google Removes South Korean Map Coordinates to Comply with Security Permit
news.summary: Alphabet's Google has removed latitude and longitude coordinates for South Korean territory from its mapping services to meet security requirements set by a government export permit.

news.headline: Reported Earlier, South Korea Says Google Removed Map Coordinates, Will Delete Military And Security Facility Street View Imagery Under February Data Export Permit
Arena Physica Collaborates with AMD to Train Heaviside Foundation Model
news.summary: Arena Physica announced a collaboration with AMD to train the next generation of its Heaviside foundation model for electromagnetism using the Lux AI supercomputer.

news.headline: What's Going On With AMD Stock Today?
news.summary: AMD stock jumped over 30% in five days as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit accelerated AI chip diversification. See why experts project $77B in AMD data-center sales by 2027.

news.headline: Broadcom Is 'Very, Very Capable,' Analyst Says As NVIDIA's Troubles Mount
news.summary: Broadcom (AVGO) is gaining ground in the AI chip race as tech giants look beyond NVIDIA amid leadership challenges and custom chip demand.
